steps.title: Leg sensors
steps.narration: Campaniform, chordotonal, and bristle neurons on the legs report load, joint angle, and touch.

steps.title: VNC local circuits
steps.narration: Most of the walk lives in the ventral nerve cord: local interneurons stitch sensors to motor neurons.

steps.title: Descending drive
steps.narration: MDN (moonwalker) and a handful of DNg cells send brain goals into the VNC.

steps.title: Leg motor neurons
steps.narration: Tibia and trochanter flexors and extensors are the muscles that actually step.
